question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

 VV, QP, LJ, GD, BX, ?, RL, MF
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac0bfdaa20a2ff09882dcb4f2825df6b2601f7ee3c4ffa968fd4b0a1ffb367fb.png] 

Logic followed here is: The positional value of 1st letter of every word is decreased by -5 and 2nd letter is decreased by -6 to get the next term.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4d46e94101e99af4be7f485955f5f30f3396c85c5c0f4d700c4aeca9a082d5b.png] 

∴ According the logic followed WR will replace the (?) mark.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
